Hi Beth — thanks for the clear list. Answers below (summary first, attachments at the bottom):

RTO / RPO (summary)
- Redwood API (hosted endpoints, standard tier): RTO = 2 hours, RPO = 15 minutes.
- Redwood API (enterprise SLA / dedicated pools): RTO = 1 hour, RPO = 5 minutes (when cross-region replication configured).
- Customer metadata / stateful stores (S3-compatible object + Dynamo-style metadata): RTO = 4 hours, RPO = 1 hour (default); can be tightened with reserved replication for enterprise tenants.

Backups & retention
- Full snapshots: weekly (stored in two regions).
- Incremental/transactional backups: every 15 minutes (journaling + incremental object checkpoints).
- Retention: default 90 days for hosted customers, configurable to 7 years for enterprise regulated workloads.
- Backups are encrypted at rest (KMS) and checksummed; copies retained in a second cloud region for geographic resiliency.

Regional failover & routing
- We run active/passive cross-region failover for hosted customers by default. Failover is automated for platform control-plane incidents using health-based routing + downstream traffic steering (global load balancers + DNS failover with low TTL where required).
- For Dedicated customers we offer configurable policies: automated, canary switchover, or manual with operational runbook.

DR tests & runbooks
- We run quarterly failover tests (last full-scope test: 2026-12-14). That test included control-plane failover, replica promotion, and smoke tests for token issuance and inference path. Outcome: passed with two minor rollback fixes documented in the test report.
- Runbook: attached (bcdr_runbook_v1.pdf). The runbook contains step-by-step failover, rollback signals, telemetry checks, and escalation contacts.

Evidence attached (zip of artifacts available on request):
- bcdr_runbook_v1.pdf (DR runbook)
- dr_test-summary-2026Q4.md (full test notes + checklist)
- backup_policy_snapshot.csv (policy excerpt + retention table)
- operational_logging_sample.log (redacted) — available on request under NDA

Attestation & next steps
- We can provide a signed attestation of the above controls. Please confirm the contact and the template you prefer; I attached a standard signed-attestation-template.docx for convenience.
- If useful, Marissa can set up a 30–45 minute technical walk-through and we can bring Rishi (platform ops) to review the DR test evidence and answer deeper questions about replication and KV state.

Let me know if the level of detail above works or if you need per-tenant export of backup manifests.

Thanks,

--
Olga Petrov
Head of Security & Compliance (interim)
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
